remote_content_publication_gate: Root final selection and document freeze plus independent exact-package approval
research_copy_policy: Only exact allowlisted files and the allowlist manifests. No full third-party videos, downloaded full HTML, raw frame collections, or broad timelines/storyboards.
prompt_policy: Preserve original saved prompt documents and raw invocation JSON. Store exact actual argument strings separately when a saved document has an added trailing newline.
baseline_source_policy: Bind input PNGs to exact immutable baseline Git blobs; do not duplicate existing source artwork.
publication_plan: One new content commit on the absent dedicated art branch, then at most one compact delivery-receipt child. Recheck branch absence immediately before create_branch. No default/runtime/workflow mutation.
verification: Reconstruct the candidate Git tree, preserve every baseline blob/mode, independently review package bytes, then verify live ref/parent/tree and full bodies for every new distinct blob. Alias paths must resolve to the same verified bytes.
